visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up of a large black iron pot embedded in a restaurant table. A wooden lid is lifted by a person wearing a black uniform and pink plastic gloves, revealing a steaming dark stew with yellow corn cakes stuck around the upper inner rim. The background shows a modern restaurant interior with wooden chairs and white tiled floors under bright studio-style lighting. (2) A series of fast cuts shows the preparation process as various ingredients are added to the bubbling broth. Metal bowls are used to pour in pieces of chicken, corn, and broth, followed by translucent sweet potato noodles and fresh green cabbage leaves. Handheld camera movements emphasize the motion of the ingredients falling into the liquid. (3) The scene shifts to a detailed presentation of side dishes. A black rectangular plate holds several round yellow corn cakes. The camera zooms in as one cake is torn in half by a person's hands to reveal a fluffy, steam-filled yellow interior. Another bowl shows marinated shrimp with long antennae in a savory dark sauce. (4) The main character's hands are shown using silver chopsticks to lift ingredients from the pot, including a large piece of chicken and long, glistening noodles. The food is then placed on top of a small white bowl filled with steamed rice. The background remains the dimly lit yet warm restaurant dining area. (5) The final sequence displays the interior of the restaurant featuring multiple tables with built-in iron pots and brown chairs. A white wall at the back features a logo and address. The video ends with a shot of the storefront's exterior, which is white with a minimalist aesthetic and 'Iron Lady' signage above the glass door.
